**In one line**: New lawsuits reportedly claim that OpenAI's focus on winning the AI race caused harm to people.

### Key points
- US local broadcaster WLOS reported the lawsuits on October 15.
- The plaintiffs reportedly say OpenAI's "insatiable hunger to win AI race" led to people getting hurt.
- The headline does not say how many plaintiffs there are, which court the cases were filed in or what harm is alleged. See the original report for details.
- No court has ruled on the claims yet.

### Why it matters
Until now, most generative AI lawsuits have been about copyright. These cases ask whether rushing products to market put users at risk. If courts accept that argument, AI companies could face stricter safety testing before launch and wider product liability.
